about: Every Puppet Script word: what it does, where it may go, what it reads and writes, its routes and who may call them, and the shared component that draws it. Pins name the latest published build; an app with no pin loads the latest.

tokens.{Name.count}: rows of declared data Name this reader can read
tokens.{form.Label}: what was typed in the field labelled Label on the same screen or dialog
tokens.{row.field}: a field of the row, only on a screen from data, never in an adds to

actions: sets status "confirmed"|"declined" (host-only screen, button in a list)

blocks.uses: uses <component>@<12-hex hash>: pin a shared component build (top level)
blocks.data: data name { fields: [a, b], read: own|private }; own = the host reads all, private = everyone only their own
blocks.screen: screen "Name" { ... }; requires: host makes it host-only; screen "Name" from data shows one row and needs a list or table of that data to open it, never first

components.summary: Placeholder mark for a person.
components.label: optional
components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen.
limits: The renderer draws this as a plain labelled box; its look is not built yet.

components.summary: A small count or status chip.
components.label: text
components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen.

components.summary: A pressable control whose hook runs actions: open a screen or dialog, add or remove a row, set a status, toast, back.
components.label: text

params.name: @primary @secondary @danger @ghost
params.description: Emphasis; at most one @primary per screen

params.name: hook
params.description: -> action ; action. Inside a list or table it is drawn on every row and acts on that row.

data.reads: Form fields on the same screen or dialog through {form.Label}.
data.writes: Through adds to, removes from and sets status.

routes.purpose: adds to: the row must match a visible action exactly

components.permissions: A write is accepted only if it matches an action the sender can see; sets status only on a host-only screen; removes only by author or host.
components.replaces: Hand-written submit handlers and row-ownership checks.

components.summary: A titled group of other elements; its hook makes the whole card pressable.
components.label: optional
components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen.

components.summary: A message box with a mic slot (filled by soma-speech when present) and Send, which runs the hook.
components.label: optional
components.template: composer "Write a message" field: Message -> toast "Sent: {form.Message}"

params.name: field
params.description: The form label Send reads (default Message)

data.writes: Through its hook, usually adds to.

components.permissions: As its hook.

components.summary: An input. @text (default), @multiline, @select with items:, @date with days:, @required.
components.label: text

params.name: label
params.description: Shown as written (no tokens); read by {form.Label}

params.name: items
params.description: Choices for @select; the server refuses other values

params.name: days
params.description: Allowed weekdays for @date: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun

data.writes: Nothing by itself; a button on the same screen sends it with {form.Label}.

components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen.
limits: A new row field holds at most 10,000 characters.

components.summary: Page intro band with a title and a subtitle.
components.label: none

params.name: subtitle
params.description: Line under the heading; tokens allowed

data.reads: Tokens only ({me.name}, {Name.count}, {row.field} on a row screen).

components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen.

components.summary: Names a host affordance (such as a voice host). Drawn as a box; no host is started.
components.label: optional
components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen.
limits: The renderer draws this as a plain labelled box; its look is not built yet.

components.summary: Placeholder for a picture, labelled with its alt text.
components.label: optional
components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen.
limits: The renderer draws this as a plain labelled box; its look is not built yet.

components.summary: A short line of static copy, drawn like text with its own class.
components.label: text
components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen.

components.summary: Run lines: the actor picks a part, Stage Read reads every other character, and the run stops on each of the actor's lines with the line hidden until they tap Next.
components.label: row-field

params.name: hint
params.description: none (default) hides the actor's line; initials shows the first letter of each word

data.reads: One field of the screen's row; the page sends only the row id and line numbers of the other parts.
data.writes: Stage Read's spend counters and audio cache.

routes.who: signed in reader of the row
routes.purpose: Body { data, rowId, field, line }; answers audio/mpeg
checks: a stage-read or line-run of this field on a screen the reader can see
the reader may read the row

components.permissions: As stage-read: only a reader of the row. A line-run never offers the narration read.

cost.allowance: Stage Read's allowance, shared with stage-read

components.replaces: A rehearsal partner reading the other parts.
limits: The chosen part is not remembered between visits.

components.summary: Text navigation; drawn as a button with the same hooks.

params.name: hook
params.description: Usually opens a screen or dialog

components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen.

components.summary: Rows of a declared data collection (or stub). With a hook that opens a screen from that data, each row opens it.

params.name: empty

components.permissions: The server filters rows by the read rule; the page never receives rows it may not show.
components.replaces: Per-user row filtering and list rendering.

components.summary: A script's assets by scene: song times with play buttons, cards as 16:9 frames, pictures and their cut pieces.
components.label: row-field

data.reads: The row and its asset files.

routes.purpose: the Mac sends a file (at most 4,500,000 bytes)

components.permissions: Readers of the row read; only the team writes.

components.summary: The evidence ledger: every narrator line and card in a video script next to its [[src: ...]] notes, with the claims that have no source marked.
components.label: text

params.name: text
params.description: The script; usually {row.text}. Its label may be any text; with {row.text} it goes on a row screen.

data.reads: The text in its label, live from a script-editor of the same field.

components.permissions: Anyone who can see the screen; it shows only text the page already has.
components.replaces: The hand-written EVIDENCE.md beside each making-of draft.
limits: A source note inside a speech is reported, not used, because a reading would speak it.
It checks that a source is named, not that the source says what the line claims.

components.summary: "Make it" panel: buttons that ask the team on Mike's Mac to time the song, make pictures, render, or anything in words.

components.summary: Storyboards as scene cards (picture, lyric and time, keep/redo/new, prompts, reorder) and cuts that know when they need rendering.

redo, add or render; anyone but the host starts held
seed a board, send pictures and renders
